item.title: Kerberos with FTP
item.description: We will setup a FTP server and use kerberos for authentication. We will use vsftpd as the FTP server and kerberos for authentication. We will use lftp to login to the FTP server and test the kerberos authentication.

item.title: IRC Chat Server
item.description: Implemented a authentication feature for a KDC based multi-threaded IRC chat server using needham schroeder protocol. There is a central Key Distribution Server which acts as a trusted party which clients can use to authenticate themselves.
